instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: There are many natural forms of electricity: for example, a flash of lightning during a storm or when your hair stands on end. Some species of fish, like electric eels, can even give electric shocks to defend themselves and attack their prey.

atoms.a: Which animal uses electricity to attack?

atoms.text: We use electric power every day. For example, when switching on a light or using this app. Electricity has become very important in our lives and makes many things, such as doing the laundry or cooking, a lot easier. However, we also consume a lot of energy (sometimes for unnecessary things) and are becoming more and more dependent on electricity.

instruction.text: What do you think happens at power plants? Select the correct answer.
Is the statement true or false?

atoms.a: People use less electricity nowadays than in the past.
Electricity can hurt us if we aren’t careful.
Electricity is generated in plant pots.
Electricity is generated in power plants.
